column1: # Hook points for mods (docs/port/MODS.md, section 4; sdk/bindings/rac2.json gives each its id).

column5: Takes a hit's points from the hero's health (the hero at 0x189E20 on NTSC-U, health at +0x24CC), after the armour's scale; the hero's state machine calls it for each hit. A hook point for mods; the game's C with none.
The pending hit for a moby from the hit ring (the damage, f32 at +0x2C; its source at +0x38), or 0: what an enemy's damage path reads. A hook point for mods; the game's C with none.
Posts a hit to moby victim from request (+0x1C its damage, f32) into the hit ring Moby_GetHitMessage reads; the weapons' shots and explosions call it. A hook point for mods; the game's C with none.
Takes rounds of a weapon's ammo (item -1: the one in hand); a weapon with no capacity has endless ammo. Rac1's TakeAmmo. A hook point for mods; the game's C with none.
A moby's death recorded: its experience, the bestiary and its bolt drop (the moby's s16 at +0xB4); crates call it too. A hook point for mods; the game's C with none.
Loads a level (new, or resumed after a death); it calls the gameplay file's loader. A hook point for mods; the game's C with none.
Eases the hero's speed (+0x1B4) toward his target speed (+0x1B0) each tick; rac1's approach_speed. A hook point for mods; the game's C with none.

Adds the nanotech levels' steps of health to *total; the recount of the most health each tick adds the boosts after it (the HUD's experience bar calls it too, ignoring total). A hook point for mods; the game's C with none.

Gives the player item id (GiveInventoryItem): nothing when owned already; else its owned and new bytes, its starting ammo, the vendor list and the quick select. A hook point for mods; the game's C with none.

Puts item id in the hero's hand, or on him for the boots, helmets and packs (by its item record's state): a request his update carries out, 1 when made. Most givers call it right after Item_Give with the same id. A hook point for mods; the game's C with none.

Steps weapon id to its next version by experience (its record to the next row, its ammo filled); nothing at its last row. The hero's experience check calls it. A hook point for mods; the game's C with none.
The vendor's Mega purchase of item id: its record two rows on (one for the two-version weapons), its experience cleared; 1 when it moved. A hook point for mods; the game's C with none.
Fills the vendor's list (g_vendorUi +0x140, 0x18-byte entries, the count at +0x740): weapons, ammo, Mega upgrades. A hook point for mods; the game's C with none.
The price in bolts of the vendor entry under the cursor (g_vendorUi +0x80); the dialog and the purchase ask it. A hook point for mods; the game's C with none.
Writes item id's experience bar colours and its version's tint to three u32 the caller has (the quick select, the weapons grid). A hook point for mods; the game's C with none.
Puts a level on the ship's map (MarkLevelAvailable); every level load calls it for its own level too. A hook point for mods; the game's C with none.
Oozla's Dynamo pickup outside the Megacorp store (class 2709): plays its scene and gives item 36; tests item 36's owned byte. A hook point for mods; the game's C with none.
Oozla's Megacorp scientist (class 2766): sells the Tractor Beam (item 46) for its record's price; tests item 46's owned byte. A hook point for mods; the game's C with none.
Oozla's Box Breaker pickup (class 4688): removes itself while item 50 is owned, else gives it. A hook point for mods; the game's C with none.
Barlow's inventor (class 3390): sells the Thermanator (item 39); tests item 39's owned byte. A hook point for mods; the game's C with none.
Barlow's level start: with item 39 owned and the area's story byte (+0x12 of 0x1395B8) clear, starts the hero in the Thermanator's area. A hook point for mods; the game's C with none.
Endako's level start: with item 13 owned and the area's story byte (+0x0D of 0x1395B8) clear, starts the hero in the Swingshot's area. A hook point for mods; the game's C with none.
Tabora's Glider (class 3675): after its scene gives item 21; tests item 21's owned byte. A hook point for mods; the game's C with none.
Joba's shady salesman (class 3733): sells the Levitator (item 8); tests item 8's owned byte. A hook point for mods; the game's C with none.
Joba's hoverbike race rider (class 2940): after the race's scene gives the Charge Boots (item 54) while they are not owned. A hook point for mods; the game's C with none.

The hoverbike race's controller of Barlow and Joba (class 3004): on Joba gives the Charge Boots (item 54) while they are not owned; on Barlow puts Feltzin on the map. A hook point for mods; the game's C with none.
Damosel's return from the Giant Clank battle (class 3841): gives the Mapper (item 5) while it is not owned. A hook point for mods; the game's C with none.
Damosel's Hypnomatic maker (class 4754): with the three parts sells the Hypnomatic (item 55); tests item 55's owned byte. A hook point for mods; the game's C with none.

The nanotech orb's update (class 0x326): its pieces fly to the hero, each giving health as it lands (1, or 4 for the special orb). A hook point for mods, under the port's own wrap (NanotechBallUpdate): the mod's replacement or the game's C runs where the wrap calls the game's.
